item.title: Court remands two over alleged assault on police officers in Ekiti
item.description: A Chief Magistrate Court sitting in Ado-Ekiti has ordered the remand of two men, Awolusi Babatunde, 45, and Awolusi Oluwaseun, 23, at the Correctional Centre over their alleged involvement in an assault on police officers and two residents.The court, presided over by Mr Abayomi Adeosun, granted bail to the third defendant, Awolusi Mary, 42, in the sum of N100,000 with two sureties in like sum.The case was adjourned till February 20, 2026, for further hearing.The prosecutor, ASP Akinwale Oriyomi,

item.title: FCT poll: ADC questions INEC’s silence on Wike’s threat to block anti-Tinubu candidates
item.description: Ahead of the Federal Capital Territory, FCT council elections, the African Democratic Congress, ADC, has questioned why the Independent National Electoral Commission, INEC, is silent on the threat by the FCT minister, Nyesom Wike, to block candidates that are not supporting President Bola Tinubu. item.title: APC National Chairman reaffirms 60/40 leadership-sharing formula in Kano
item.description: The National Chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda, has restated the party’s decision to maintain a 60/40 leadership-sharing formula between new defectors and existing APC members in Kano State. Yilwatda reportedly remarked during a visit to Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf. item.title: APC apologizes for inviting dead Army General, Supreme Court Justice to stakeholders meeting
item.description: The All Progressives Congress, APC, in Cross River State, has apologized after wrongly listing a deceased Army General and a serving Justice of the Supreme Court of Nigeria among stakeholders invited to a meeting with Governor Bassey Edet Otu. The party specifically apologized to the family of late Major General Edward Ushie Unimna, whose name appeared on the invitation despite his death and burial in 2025. item.title: I can never be anti-Peter Obi – Dele Momodu
item.description: A chieftain of the African Democratic Congress, ADC, Dele Momodu, has dismissed claims of being opposed to former presidential candidate, Peter Obi. Momodu stated that he has consistently supported the former Anambra State governor. He was reacting to an X user @Blazeregent who charged him to purge himself of anti-Obi sentiments. item.title: US warns visa fraud, overstays by Nigerians may attract stricter scrutiny
item.description: The United States mission in Nigeria has warned Nigerians against engaging in visa fraud, saying such actions would attract stricter scrutiny for all applicants. In an X post shared on Monday, the US said it remains committed to protecting the integrity of its visa system through rigorous screening processes. “Those who seek to commit fraud bring increased scrutiny on all visa applicants. item.title: “You Are Doing an Excellent Job,” Tinubu Tells NSA Ribadu
item.description: President Bola Tinubu says Nuhu Ribadu, the national security adviser (NSA), is doing an “excellent job” in coordinating the fight against banditry and terrorism. Speaking on Monday in Yola, while inaugurating projects completed by the Adamawa state government, Tinubu said he is proud of Ribadu. item.title: 100 U.S military personnel arrive in Nigeria
item.description: The Defence Headquarters has announced the arrival of about 100 United States military personnel and associated equipment at Bauchi Airfield.
